items.item_text: 01. Information I provide to the following supplemental questions will be reviewed as part of the application process. Questions that are not fully and completely answered will be considered grounds for disqualification from the examination process. Stating "see resume" in lieu of a complete response to these questions is not acceptable. Select "Yes" to indicate that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes
02. Do you have a high school diploma or equivalent? Options: Yes | No
03. Do you have a valid California Driver's License (or an out of state license and are willing to obtain a California Driver's License upon offer of employment)? Options: Yes | No

04. Do you have a valid Forklift Certification? Options: Yes | No, but I am willing to obtain a forklift certificate within 6 months of employment | No, and I am NOT willing to obtain a forklift certificate

05. If you answered YES to the above question, return to the main application in the attachments section and attach a copy of your certification. Select YES to indicate that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes
06. How many years of verifiable job related experience do you have working in a warehouse or distribution center? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1-2 years | 2-3 years | 3 years or more

07. How many years of verifiable job related experience do you have operating a box delivery truck exceeding 16 feet in length? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1-2 years | 2-3 years | 3 years or more

08. How many years of verifiable job related experience do you have that includes methods used in the receipt, storage and issuance or delivery of a wide variety of goods? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1-2 years | 2-3 years | 3 years or more

09. How many years of verifiable job related experience do you have using computer based shipping and receiving processes, Microsoft Office programs, electronic hand held scanners for deliveries and document scanners? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1-2 years | 2-3 years | 3 years or more

10. How many years of verifiable job related experience do you have operating multiple model forklifts, electric pallet jacks, order pickers and other warehouse related equipment? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1-2 years | 2-3 years | 3 years or more

11. How many years of verifiable job related experience do you have working in a position that required direct customer interaction? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1-2 years | 2-3 years | 3 years or more

12. According to the job announcement, check the level of your proficiency to perform the minimum qualifications listed: Receive shipments and verify specifications, quantity and quality Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations | Limited ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations

13. Prepare orders from requisitions and pull stock for delivery Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations | Limited ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations

14. Conduct physical inventories, verify stock and identify losses Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations | Limited ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations

15. Load a delivery vehicle with a variety of supplies and materials Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations | Limited ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations

16. Research discrepancies in records such as purchase orders and packing slips Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations | Limited ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations

17. Maintain files, records, schedules, calendars, catalogs, and inventory Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations | Limited ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations

18. Operate a computer, related software and various office equipment Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations | Limited ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations

19. The questions below are designed to indicate whether you are willing to perform the duty listed. Check YES if you are willing to perform this duty or NO if you are not. Please keep in mind that all of the duties listed are REQUIRED of the position. If you are not willing to do any one of the duties listed, you will not be considered in the recruitment process. Select "Yes" to indicate that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes
20. Loading and unloading delivery trucks. Options: Yes | No
21. Driving a vehicle during adverse weather conditions. Options: Yes | No
22. Performing heavy physical labor. Options: Yes | No
23. Working on ladders and at heights. Options: Yes | No
24. Working around and with machinery having moving parts. Options: Yes | No
25. Working around loud or noisy equipment. Options: Yes | No
26. Working around fumes from vehicle and equipment operation. Options: Yes | No
27. Working around and in cold food storage units and freezers. Options: Yes | No

28. Describe your work experience as it applies to inventory control, inventory tracking and stock rotation processes. Be sure to include the size of the warehouse and the type of materials for which you were responsible.
29. Describe a situation where you had a difficult warehouse/delivery driver event and how you resolved it.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES: Receive, prepare and distribute incoming and outgoing mail, materials, supplies, food and equipment to various District locations; prepare and maintain routine records related to assigned activities. Receive warehouse stock orders, pull, wrap and load delivery trucks; load and unload delivery vehicles; store materials, supplies and equipment in a neat, orderly and efficient manner. Shelve and store items received in the appropriate section of the warehouse; place food items in racks, coolers or freezers as required; rotate perishable and nonperishable inventory as needed; assure food shipments are not spoiled or damaged. Drive a vehicle to various locations along assigned routes to deliver goods; maintain cleanliness of vehicles; service and run safety checks on assigned vehicle. Monitor and update computerized inventory control records as needed; perform periodic warehouse inventory activities; plan storage locations and utilize space efficiently. Inspect shipments against packing slips and purchase orders, report damage, shortage or discrepancies. Greet visitors and District personnel at the warehouse; receive and issue materials, supplies and equipment; coordinate maintenance materials for special projects. Communicate with school and District personnel regarding the pickup and delivery of orders; communicate with outside vendors regarding pricing and status of orders. Pick up and authorize supplies from the main District warehouse. Maintain warehouse in a clean and orderly condition; maintain cleanliness of Warehouse Department equipment. Operate a District vehicle and a variety of warehouse equipment including forklifts, pallet jacks, dollies and postage meters. Perform related duties as assigned. KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES: KNOWLEDGE OF: Materials and supplies inventory control. Basic methods, practices and terminology used in warehouse operations. Use and terminology of requisitions, purchase orders, invoices and other warehouse documents. Proper methods of storing equipment, materials and supplies. Proper loading and unloading of trucks. Shipping and receiving procedures. Operation of equipment and machines used in the receipt, storage and shipping of supplies, materials and equipment. Record-keeping techniques. Interpersonal skills using tact, patience and courtesy. Proper lifting techniques. Basic computer operation. Health and safety regulations. Basic math. ABILITY TO: Perform physical and clerical duties involved in packing, storing and shipping supplies. Receive, store, ship and deliver materials, supplies and equipment to various locations. Operate a variety of warehouse machines and equipment. Participate in warehouse operations. Take inventory and maintain accurate control systems. Utilize space efficiently and effectively. Order parts and supplies according to established guidelines. Maintain records related to inventory and work performed. Observe health and safety regulations. Understand and follow oral and written instructions. Prioritize and schedule work. Operate a computer. WORKING CONDITIONS: ENVIRONMENT: Warehouse environment. Driving a vehicle to conduct work. Fumes from vehicle and equipment operation. PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Sitting or standing for extended periods of time. Lifting, carrying, pushing and pulling heavy objects. Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer and various warehouse equipment. Reaching overhead, above the shoulders and horizontally. Bending at the waist, kneeling and crouching. Heavy physical labor. Seeing to read a variety of documents. Climbing ladders to reach supplies and equipment. HAZARDS: Driving a vehicle during adverse weather conditions. Working around and with machinery having moving parts. Working at heights. Personnel Commission July 2024 Personnel Commission April 2001 Ewing Consulting, Inc. December 1999
